JAGRITI SHARMA Operations expert – International Trade finance – Corporate banking 91- 6382343663| jagriti3171@gmail.com | Chennai , India

Professional Summary

Corporate Banking Operations professional with 6 years of experience in International Trade Finance, specializing in Letter of Credit (LC) transactions, serving as a Subject Matter Expert (SME). Proven expertise in end-to-end processing and authorization of SWIFT messages (MT103, MT202), ISO 20022 formats (PACS.008 & PACS.009). Proven expertise in analyzing, improving, and automating trade finance processes, acting as a subject matter expert (SME) for payment flows and transaction life cycles. Known for a detail-oriented approach, strong analytical skills, and a commitment to continuous learning. Open-minded and adaptable, with a keen interest in embracing new technologies and evolving methodologies in fast-paced, dynamic environments.

Job Summary Current Employer - Barclays Global Service Centre Private Limited (Sept 2019 – Aug 2025) Designation – Senior Trade Finance Analyst Department – Trade and working capital

Core Competencies

Business & Functional Requirements Gathering (BRD , FRD) • Trade Finance & Payments domain expertise • SWIFT Messaging (MT103, MT202, MT700 series) • • Risk & Compliance Management • Cross-border Payments • Team Leadership & Training • Operational Excellence • Process Automation & Improvement • MS Suite • UAT & Implementation support • SQL, Power BI & Tableau - Basics Experience

Business & Functional Requirements Gathering (BRD , FRD) • Trade Finance & Payments domain expertise • SWIFT Messaging (MT103, MT202, MT700 series) • • Risk & Compliance Management • Cross-border Payments • Team Leadership & Training • Operational Excellence • Process Automation & Improvement • MS Suite • UAT & Implementation support • SQL, Power BI & Tableau - Basics Experience

ISO 20022 (PACS.008 & PACS.009) Migration & Message Mapping

Acted as SME for Letter of Credit operations and advised internal teams on transaction structuring and compliance.

SME in reviewing transactional history, documentations with a fair understanding of Anti money laundering and sanctions applicable to payments.

Conversant with various method of settlements which includes but not limited to SWIFT, ISO messages and Internal entries.

Authorized high-value cross-border transactions ensuring adherence to international trade and AML regulations.

• Led the analysis and design of enhancements for LC payment systems aligned with ISO

20022 migration.

Mapped existing business processes and identified gaps, resulting in a 25% reduction in transaction processing time.

Skilled in stakeholder management , business process modeling , data driven decision making and training the colleagues.

Supported digitalization of trade finance workflows, contributing to a successful platform upgrade.

Expertise in handling TRADE360 platform. • Analyzing the root cause for SWIFT rejection and timely resolution. • Prioritization, optimization and accuracy along with professional communication are strengths.

Problem solving, critical thinking, attention to details. • Prepared training modules, identified training needs, conducted refresher trainings to increase quality and quantity of the transactions handled by the team.

Collaborated with cross functional teams and assisted in documenting business requirements for project/process and identified areas for improvement.

Reduced processing errors by implementing internal checks and updating standard operating procedures.

Assisted in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) , validating system changes against business requirements.

Process Advisor - Trade finance Barclays Global Service Centre Private Limited (Sept 2019 – Oct 2023)

Handled SWIFT communications (MT103, MT202) and monitored payment queues for accuracy and SLA adherence.

Conducted daily reconciliations and flagged exceptions to relevant teams for resolution. • Processed import/export LC transactions, reimbursements, and discounting procedures. • Actively contribute to the team in maintenance and execution of necessary reports to senior management and timely identification, resolution of potential risk, complaints • Key team member in analyzing and resolving settlement exceptions, escalate risk items to senior management.

Assisted the team head with ad-hoc duties and assignments. • Self-starter who initiates cross training and upskilling. • Hands on experience and proven expertise record in using applications like Mainframe, Global Pay Plus , Trade flow & Trade Manager , Full Serve.

Recognitions



Identified process gaps and suggested possible automations for implementation which has increased the team’s productivity.

Optimized, refined and revamped the Quality assurance standards for the payment process which has resulted in increase of customer satisfaction.

Expert checker with a track record of 100% accuracy without any risk events or customer complaints.

Recognized for assisting and for providing expertise advise to the technical project team for automation of Trade platform(TRADE360)

• Certifications achieved in Business Analysis , Data Analysis.

Education : Post graduation – M.sc Microbiology – 2017 - Ethiraj college for Women , Chennai
